metadataReview.note: Reviewed location: the marker identifies Elm Brook Hill, also called Bloody Angle, on the Battle Road where the 19 April 1775 ambush occurred. It represents this documented road sector, not every firing position or the full Lexington–Concord battle. NPS supplies the point; no metric historical accuracy is established. The existing date is retained.
